LanguageData.CinderShell_Erosion.description: A type of explosive shell that uses amorphous polymers as charges, which will erode the armor of affected enemies during explosion, causing them to suffer higher subsequent damage. Can be fired from mortars or installed as a trap. Explodes when damaged.
